::: {#rem-gan-loss}

#### The generator's loss in practice

@exm-gan follows @goodfellow2014generative [section 3], who train $G$ to maximize $\logf{D(G(\vecf{Z}))}$
instead of minimizing $V(D, G)$.
This gives larger [gradients](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/linear-regression.html#def-gradient) early in training,
when $D$ rejects the made-up points easily.

:::
